name: Shoji Hiroki
source:
A tough-talking detective who's good at what he does.

He's good at his job and very popular with the ladies,
but he avoids getting into deep relationships.

Perhaps because he's always out and about at night,
he's a habitual sleeper in the office during the day.

Apparently, he often laughs when he's drunk.
[From [url=https://and-zero.com/characters/hiroki]Official site[/url]]
